programme.title: Computer Science < Brown University
programme.degree: Computer Science concentration, Sc.B. (standard and professional tracks) or A.B.
programme.how_found: Search (official domain only) -> University Bulletin, The College, Concentrations, Computer Science (bulletin.brown.edu/the-college/concentrations/comp/); department page cs.brown.edu/degrees/undergrad/.
programme.notes: Language: 'Since English is the language of instruction at Brown' (https://admission.brown.edu/international/english-proficiency). Owner ruling: US university without a CS-specific admissions page; the university-wide undergraduate admissions page is the source, scoped to the university.

english.quote: The following minimum scores are expected in most cases: TOEFL internet-based exam taken prior to January 2026: minimum score of 105 TOEFL internet-based exam taken January 2026 and later: minimum score of 5.5 IELTS: minimum score of 8.0 Duolingo Test of English: minimum score of 130
english.notes: 'expected in most cases' minimums; Brown 'highly recommend[s]' a test for non-native speakers rather than strictly requiring it; PTE 75, Cambridge C1/C2 191. Official reports needed by May 2027 for fall 2027 entrants. No per-section minimum.

gpa.notes: No GPA or grade minimum: 'you should feel confident that your accomplishments would allow you to be admitted to a leading university in your own country' (https://admission.brown.edu/international/admission-criteria). Prose only.

deadline.quote: Regular Decision applicants receive a decision by early April. Deadline: January 5
deadline.notes: Regular Decision; Early Decision November 1. Year not printed on the page (current cycle = fall 2027 entry). 'There is not a separate application for international applicants.' (admission.brown.edu/international). Owner ruling: US university without a CS-specific admissions page; the university-wide undergraduate admissions page is the source, scoped to the university.

tuition.notes: '2026 - 2027 Undergraduate Student Tuition & Fees' table: Annual $74,568, Fall $37,284, Spring $37,284. admission.brown.edu/tuition-aid/tuition-fees still shows 2025-2026 ($71,700). Office of Student Financial Services (sfs.brown.edu, reached from www.brown.edu/about/administration/bursar/).

value.name: Brown need-based financial aid (The Brown Promise)

scholarship_exists.quote: Brown meets 100 percent of demonstrated financial need.
scholarship_exists.notes: 'Financial aid is need based.' and 'Brown University does not offer any merit awards.' (international/financial-aid). NEED_BASED_POSSIBLE.

scholarship_international.quote: International students are eligible to apply for University financial aid. We meet full demonstrated need for students who are admitted provided they apply for financial aid at the time they apply for admission.
scholarship_international.notes: 'Brown will be need-blind for international students beginning with the Class of 2029.'
